Continue from the [parent #5090 handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md).

Preserve the exact allocator continuation for #5090, #5108 and #5095. Source snapshot `46e5c249e5714be644a406c52addcae312ad372f` has 9,943 source paths, manifest SHA-256 `63123da83b3b68a0f060b6a1f5fd2c8c3a7a5737e694a2b0295ba48d35efed78`, with 45 changed paths relative to its recorded base.

The composed allocator membership component previously passed 184 top-level/330 named controls in each pinned Mac normal/race build. That scoped evidence does not qualify the entire pre-WAL pipeline, joint metadata fit, runtime integration or performance. The prior mistaken reservation-hint fixture failure is retained. Exact candidate membership, reused-ID coverage, uncertain publication and constructor lifetime obligations remain mandatory.

This draft is source preservation at the user's handoff boundary. No formatting, new test runs or merges were performed. The parent #5090 handoff records the original evidence and source bindings. Integrate deliberately with the overlapping composed #5113/#5093 snapshot; do not blindly cherry-pick both lanes. Keep unmerged until required graph review, CI and outcome gates pass.
